text: {"lessons":["My account moved up and down despite making no trades, reminding me that short-term price changes are uncertain and past moves do not predict the next one.","I should judge each holding by its role and risk in my overall portfolio, rather than letting its purchase price or my reluctance to admit a loss dictate my decision.","When I review my account, I should make deliberate, well-supported decisions—not trade just to feel in control, or sell solely for the satisfaction of locking in a gain."]}
